name: console-startup-timeout
goal: Find, with stage timings, why the Reports console browser run's second server exceeded 420 s under verification; repair only a cause that evidence shows.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Reported failure: second config.webServer of packages/reports/playwright.config.ts timed out after 420000 ms before any test. Expected: /api/health answers within 420 s. A faithful unchanged run of harness-console:evidence at 0dc9663 (same command, cwd, isolation, eight verification variables, fresh setup build) passed 5 of 5; that server was healthy after 169.5 s. Not reproduced: no failing test exists, so red stays pending.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
